results.name: projectlibre-help
results.stdout:
usage: generate_project.py [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [-t HOURS_PER_DAY] [--open]
                           [--quiet] [--verify]
                           input

任务清单 JSON -> ProjectLibre MSPDI XML

positional arguments:
  input                 任务清单 JSON 文件

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT   输出 XML 路径 (默认: <输入目录>/<项目名>.xml)
  -t, --hours-per-day HOURS_PER_DAY
                        每日工时(默认 8)
  --open                生成后用 ProjectLibre 打开
  --quiet               只输出 XML 到 stdout, 不打印摘要 (配合 -o 仍写文件)
  --verify              生成后用 MPXJ 重新解析校验 (需本机 JDK 8+; MPXJ 路径用环境变量 MPXJ_HOME
                        覆盖)

results.name: pptx-export-help
results.stdout:
usage: export_pptx.py [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--transition {fade,none}]
                      [--embed-fonts | --no-embed-fonts] [--browser]
                      [--keep-browser-raw] [--force]
                      input

Export a PPTD project to PPTX. Default: local patched official WASM (offline).
Optional --browser uses the local neo-ppt mirror (also offline).

positional arguments:
  input                 .pptd manifest or project directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output, -o OUTPUT   output .pptx path
  --transition {fade,none}
                        slide transition written to every slide (default:
                        fade)
  --embed-fonts         embed fonts when available (browser path; default)
  --no-embed-fonts      disable font embedding (browser path)
  --browser             force local neo-ppt browser UI path instead of Node
                        WASM
  --keep-browser-raw    also keep the unpatched browser download beside the
                        output
  --force               replace an existing output file
